name: Coffee Pub Studio
description: Coffee Pub Studio is a boutique design and development shop. I provoke what's possible and then build it, and the products I make solve real problems for people who plan trips, make streams and run tabletop games.
buildNote: Built by hand, with AI assistance added to the toolbox over the past year.

studioApp.label: Coffee Pub Showrunner
studioApp.text: A free desktop app for macOS and Windows that feeds OBS the sources, audio, video and metadata a streamed game needs. OBS still does the streaming and recording; Showrunner does the setup and the cueing.
